blocks.en: The next theorem concerns compactness of imbeddings between Sobolev spaces.
blocks.zh: 下一个定理讨论 Sobolev 空间之间嵌入的紧性.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be bounded and let $k$ be a non-negative integer. Assume that $\Omega$ has the $(k+1)$-extension property. Then\[H^{k+1}(\Omega)\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}H^k(\Omega),\]i.e., $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ is compactly imbedded in $H^k(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 有界, $k$ 为非负整数. 假设 $\Omega$ 具有 $(k+1)$ 阶延拓性质. 那么\[H^{k+1}(\Omega)\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}H^k(\Omega),\]即 $H^{k+1}(\Omega)$ 紧嵌入 $H^k(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: thm:compact-successive-sobolev-orders

blocks.en: As a consequence of Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-successive-sobolev-orders}, we shall establish Ehrling\textquotesingle s lemma, which allows us to introduce an equivalent norm on $H^k(\Omega)$. We first give an abstract version.
blocks.zh: 作为 Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-successive-sobolev-orders} 的推论, 将建立 Ehrling 引理, 它使我们能够在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 上引入等价范数. 先给出一个抽象版本.
